independence: Reviewer authored the matching/DNA implementation, not the material generator, rendering wrappers or B08 repair. This pass independently assesses those rendering changes. It is not an independent audit of matching code.
method: Direct visual comparison of six full-avatar renders and enlarged textile regions with all six supplied suit photographs.
Direct inspection of original B01/B06/B10 registered jacket assets and corrected material detail/full-avatar views.
Direct comparison of B08 before/after waist render crops.
Independent Pillow/NumPy verification of nine original/display file hashes, every alpha byte, and linen RGB means.
Read source-bound material resolver, bounded B08 repair and direct rendering no-tie guard; inspected their target-ID and source-hash scope.

findings.observation: Warm medium-dark gray with a brown cast and fine interlocking Glen/hound check. Reference close-up has more local contrast under its lighting; the full-avatar scale keeps the same restrained check family. Jacket and trousers agree in color and pattern. Approved notch lapels, two-button front, pockets and silhouette remain recognizable.

Dark muted slate blue-gray with visible fine intersecting check and streaked weave. The corrected garment is not flat navy or a featureless solid. Relative darkness, subdued check and paired trouser texture agree with the clothed reference.

Medium slate/steel blue-gray fine near-solid fabric, visibly lighter than S13. No prominent navy plaid remains. Lapel, chest pocket and lower pocket outlines remain visible. The mild violet-gray cast also appears in the supplied warm-lit phone images.

Original navy color, patch-pocket outline, lapels and open jacket geometry remain. New cross-weave has small irregular slubs and subdued cloth wrinkles; it reads as matte linen at full-avatar and textile-detail scales. Comparison is to the approved registered render; no new physical-fabric claim is made.

Very pale desaturated sage color and embroidered crest remain. Coarse original dot/knit appearance is replaced by fine matte natural-looking linen weave. Original button, chest emblem, patch pockets, folds and silhouette are retained.

Warm camel/taupe-beige color, button and patch-pocket design remain. The original exaggerated geometric texture becomes restrained under a fine slubbed linen weave, consistent with the approved near-solid/faint-texture DNA. Color ordering and local garment shading remain.

Both abrupt horizontal inner-panel scars visible in the before crop are removed. Continuous cloth now reaches the same original jacket opening; the adjacent shirt, tie and lower gap are unchanged. Real pocket edges remain outside the bounded repair.

limitations: Phone screenshots have uncontrolled lighting, exposure and white balance; this validates visible relative color and texture, not calibrated physical color.
No physical fabric composition percentage or exact real-world pattern repeat can be established from these images.
B01/B06/B10 preserve the current approved rendered colors and designs; their historical phone-photo files are not present in this checkout.
Linen microtexture is a generated display material. It preserves source alpha/geometry and color rather than claiming a new garment photograph.
Visual inspection covers representative DS001 open-collar frames plus the supplied B08 tied crop; comprehensive shirt/state/mode/occasion and unrelated-garment matrices are separate automated gates.
